# IFlexibleTipper
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IFlexibleTipper.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ITipper](./i-tipper.md)

**Title:**
IFlexibleTipper

Interface for the FlexibleTipper contract that extends the base Tipper
with an optional High-Water Mark (HWM) performance fee.

Supports three fee modes:
- AUM: Time-based assets-under-management fee (original Tipper behavior)
- PERFORMANCE: HWM-based fee charged only on new profit
- BOTH: AUM + PERFORMANCE fees applied together


## Functions
### feeType

Returns the current fee type


```solidity
function feeType() external view returns (FeeType);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`FeeType`|The current FeeType enum value|


### performanceFeeRate

Returns the current performance fee rate


```solidity
function performanceFeeRate() external view returns (Percentage);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`Percentage`|The performance fee rate as a Percentage|


### highWaterMark

Returns the current high-water mark

The HWM is the highest-ever assetsPerShare ratio, scaled by 1e18


```solidity
function highWaterMark() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The high-water mark value|


## Events
### FeeTypeChanged
Emitted when the fee type changes, with HWM reset details for auditability


```solidity
event FeeTypeChanged(FeeType oldFeeType, FeeType newFeeType, uint256 oldHWM, uint256 newHWM);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`oldFeeType`|`FeeType`|The previous fee type|
|`newFeeType`|`FeeType`|The new fee type|
|`oldHWM`|`uint256`|The HWM value before the reset|
|`newHWM`|`uint256`|The HWM value after the reset (current assetsPerShare)|

### PerformanceFeeRateUpdated
Emitted when the performance fee rate is updated


```solidity
event PerformanceFeeRateUpdated(Percentage newRate);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newRate`|`Percentage`|The new performance fee rate|

### HighWaterMarkUpdated
Emitted when the high-water mark is updated


```solidity
event HighWaterMarkUpdated(uint256 newHighWaterMark);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newHighWaterMark`|`uint256`|The new high-water mark value (assetsPerShare * 1e18)|

### PerformanceFeeAccrued
Emitted when performance fee shares are accrued


```solidity
event PerformanceFeeAccrued(uint256 feeShares);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`feeShares`|`uint256`|The number of shares minted as performance fee|

## Errors
### PerformanceFeeRateTooHigh
Thrown when the performance fee rate exceeds the maximum allowed (50%)


```solidity
error PerformanceFeeRateTooHigh();
```

### PerformanceFeeRateCannotBeZero
Thrown when attempting to set the performance fee rate to zero


```solidity
error PerformanceFeeRateCannotBeZero();
```

## Enums
### FeeType
Enum representing the available fee types


```solidity
enum FeeType {
    AUM,
    PERFORMANCE,
    BOTH
}
```

**Variants**

|Name|Description|
|----|-----------|
|`AUM`|Assets Under Management fee (time-based, annualized)|
|`PERFORMANCE`|High-Water Mark performance fee (profit-based)|
|`BOTH`|Both AUM and Performance fees applied together|
